create_flux_model_specification: create a FluxModelSpecification to load and configure FLUX.1-dev diffusion model components
build_flux_latent_encoder: build a FluxLatentEncodeProcessor to encode images or videos into latents using the Flux VAE
run_flux_forward_pass: run the forward pass of a FluxModelSpecification to compute transformer predictions and targets
test_flux_validation_generation: test FluxModelSpecification validation by generating images from a prompt via the FluxPipeline
save_flux_lora_weights: save LoRA weights and scheduler from a trained FluxModelSpecification transformer to disk
